description: Path -> module mapping + P0/P1/P2 diff rules for the cinema PreToolUse anti-regression hook. Edited as new invariants are documented. Companion to business-flows.json (cross-module keyword detection).

booking.label: Booking & seat locking
top_p0: Seat-lock store is a process-local static ConcurrentDictionary keyed {showTimeId}:{roomId}:{seatId}. Do not make it instance-scoped.
Locks auto-expire after 5 minutes (IsSeatLocked / TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5)). Don't drop the expiry.
UnlockSeat is owner-scoped (compares ConnectionId). Don't let any connection release another's seat.
CreateBookingAsync creates Invoice with Status=InvoiceStatus.Pending inside a transaction. Never create as Paid; never drop the transaction.
CancelBookingAsync guards: only from Pending (status != Pending -> return false) and only the owning userId.
Status logic uses InvoiceStatus / SeatStatus enums, never magic integers.

auth.label: Authentication & authorization
top_p0: Bad credentials must throw Unauthorized (never return a token).
RegisterAsync refuses a duplicate email.
The JWT carries the Role claim that drives [Authorize(Roles = _adminRole)].
Admin endpoints stay gated by the Admin role.
FE stores the JWT under the localStorage key 'cinema_token'.

catalog.label: Movie & catalog admin (CRUD)
top_p0: Write endpoints (Create/Update/Delete movie + catalog) stay Admin-only via [Authorize(Roles = _adminRole)].
DeleteAsync is a SOFT delete (IsActive = false), never a hard row delete.
List endpoints honor PagingSearchDTO + DefaultSearchResults<T>.
Admin FE routes are behind adminGuard.

inventory.label: Inventory, combos & storage plans
top_p0: QuantityOnHand changes ONLY via FoodAndDrinkStore.TryApplyStockDeltaAsync (guarded, never below zero), always with a StockMovement ledger row. Never assign QuantityOnHand directly.
StockMovement is insert-only: no Update/Delete. Corrections are new compensating rows.
CreateBookingAsync deducts stock inside its transaction, in ascending item-id order; combos expand to tracked components (a combo holds no stock).
Restock on Cancel/Refund/Expire reads GetNetSaleQuantitiesAsync (ledger), never the combo recipe, and is idempotent.
StoragePlan Receive only from Approved and guarded by RowVersion (SaveAsync(plan) before stock moves).
Approve/Reject use RoleNames.StockApprovers (Admin, TheaterManager) - TheaterStaff cannot approve.
Back-office actions call User.TryGetBackOfficeScope and answer Forbid() (403), NEVER 401 (the SPA logs out on 401); staff stay pinned to their theater.
CreateFoodAndDrinkRequest/UpdateFoodAndDrinkRequest carry no inventory or combo fields.
Combos can never be tracked or nested, and stay within one theater.

diff_rules.label: Status compared/assigned as a magic integer instead of the enum
diff_rules.message: Status value hardcoded as a number. Use the named enum member (InvoiceStatus.Pending/Paid/Cancelled/Failed, SeatStatus.Available/Reserved/Occupied) — a renumbered enum would silently corrupt status logic.

diff_rules.label: Physical delete on a soft-delete entity (Movie / Invoice)
diff_rules.message: Physical removal detected on Movie/Invoice. These use soft delete (IsActive = false) to preserve history and FKs. Confirm this is intentional before writing.

diff_rules.label: [AllowAnonymous] introduced on an endpoint
diff_rules.message: [AllowAnonymous] added — confirm this endpoint is genuinely meant to be public. Admin/user endpoints must stay behind [Authorize] / [Authorize(Roles = _adminRole)].
